system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'S3 bucket for application user uploads with access controls'

Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Name of the S3 bucket for user uploads'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Bucket name must be lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and periods'

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Environment name (e.g., dev, staging, prod)'
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  LoggingBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Name of the S3 bucket for access logs (must exist)'
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasLoggingBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LoggingBucketName, '']]

Resources:
  UserUploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref BucketName
      AccessControl: Private
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpirationInDays: 90
      LoggingConfiguration:
        !If
          - HasLoggingBucket
          - DestinationBucketName: !Ref LoggingBucketName
            LogFilePrefix: !Sub '${BucketName}/'
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref BucketName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: UserUploads

  UserUploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UserUploadsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false
          - Sid: DenyIncorrectEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': 'AES256'
          - Sid: DenyNoEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Null:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': true

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: 'Name of the user uploads S3 bucket'
    Value: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
  BucketArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the user uploads S3 bucket'
    Value: !GetAtt UserUploadsBucket.Arn
  BucketDomainName:
    Description: 'Domain name of the user uploads S3 bucket'
    Value: !GetAtt UserUploadsBucket.DomainName
